phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.notes: Checked official Rustup, Cargo, and Tauri v2 installation/build references.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.notes: Memory bootstrap returned ready_to_bootstrap and hot anchors were read.

phases.label: Installation and implementation
phases.notes: Installed project-local npm dependencies, fetched Cargo dependencies, generated Tauri icons, tracked Cargo.lock, configured ad-hoc signing, removed duplicate build script calls, and fixed dompurify audit with an override.

phases.label: Verification
phases.notes: Ran npm audit/check/test/build, cargo test/build, tauri build, codesign, hdiutil verify, and app open/quit smoke.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.notes: Prepared omission, resource, grounding, installation, request trace, and evaluation input records.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.notes: Will update after final git actions.

bottleneck_analysis.bottleneck_notes: Timing started after initial intake, so this record is partial. The main rework was resolving missing Tauri icons, local macOS signing verification, and npm audit cleanup.
